data.name: HYSD Bar Reinforcement in Superstructure
data.description: Supplying, fitting and placing HYSD bar reinforcement in super-structure complete as per drawing and technical specifications.

data.name: High Tensile Steel Wires/Strands
data.description: High tensile steel wires/strands including all accessories for stressing, stressing operations and grouting complete as per drawing and Technical Specifications.

data.name: Cement Concrete Wearing Coat M30 Grade
data.description: Providing and laying Cement concrete wearing coat M-30 grade including reinforcement complete as per drawing and Technical Specifications.

data.name: Mastic Asphalt Wearing Course
data.description: Providing and laying 12 mm thick mastic asphalt wearing course on top of deck slab excluding prime coat with paving grade bitumen meeting the requirements given in Table 500-29, prepared by using mastic cooker and laid to required level and slope after cleaning the surface, including providing antiskid surface with bitumen precoated fine grained hard stone chipping of 9.5 mm nominal size complete as per Clause 515.

data.name: Precast RCC Railing M30 Grade
data.description: Construction of precast RCC railing of M30 Grade, aggregate size not exceeding 12 mm, true to line and grade, tolerance of vertical RCC post not to exceed 1 in 500, centre to centre spacing between vertical posts not to exceed 2000 mm, leaving adequate space between vertical posts for expansion, complete as per approved drawings and technical specifications.

data.name: RCC Railing M30 Grade In-situ
data.description: Construction of RCC railing of M30 Grade in-situ with 20 mm nominal size aggregate, true to line and grade, tolerance of vertical RCC post not to exceed 1 in 500, centre to centre spacing between vertical posts not to exceed 2000 mm, leaving adequate space between vertical posts for expansion, complete as per approved drawings and technical specifications.

data.name: Mild Steel Railing
data.description: Providing, fitting and fixing mild steel railing complete as per drawing and Technical Specification.

data.name: Drainage Spouts
data.description: Drainage spouts complete as per drawing and Technical Specifications.

data.name: PCC M15 Grade Leveling Course Below Approach Slab
data.description: PCC M15 Grade leveling course below approach slab complete as per drawing and Technical Specification.

data.name: RCC Approach Slab
data.description: Reinforced cement concrete approach slab including reinforcement and formwork complete as per drawing and Technical Specification.

data.name: Precast Prestensioned Concrete Girders
data.description: Providing, precasting, transportation and placing in position precast pretensioned concrete girders as per drawing and technical specifications.

data.name: Painting on Concrete Surface
data.description: Providing and applying 2 coats of water based cement paint to unplastered concrete surface after cleaning the surface of dirt, dust, oil, grease, efflorescence and applying paint @ of 1 litre for 2 sqm.

data.name: Buried Joint
data.description: Providing and laying a buried expansion joint, expansion gap being 20 mm, covered with 12 mm thick, 200 mm wide galvanised weldable structural steel plate as per IS:2062, placed symmetrical to centre line of the joint, resting freely over the top surface of the deck concrete, welding of 8 mm dia. 100 mm long galvanised nails spaced 300 mm c/c along the centre line of the plate, all as specified in Clause 2604.

data.name: Corrugated Copper Plate in Expansion Joint
data.description: Providing & fixing 2 mm thick corrugated copper plate in expansion joint complete as per drawing & Technical Specification.

data.name: Compressible Fibre Board in Expansion Joint
data.description: Providing & fixing 20 mm thick compressible fibre board in expansion joint complete as per drawing & Technical Specification.

data.name: Premoulded Joint Filler
data.description: Providing and fixing in position 20 mm thick premoulded joint filler in expansion joint for fixed ends of simply supported spans not exceeding 10 m to cater for a horizontal movement upto 20 mm, covered with sealant complete as per drawing and technical specifications.

data.name: Joint Sealing Compound
data.description: Providing and filling joint sealing compound as per drawings and technical specifications with coarse sand and 6 per cent bitumen by weight.

data.name: Asphaltic Plug Joint
data.description: Providing and laying of asphaltic plug joint to provide for horizontal movement of 25 mm and vertical movement of 2 mm, depth of joint varying from 75 mm to 100 mm, width varying from 500 mm to 750 mm (in traffic direction), covered with a closure plate of 200 mm × 6 mm of weldable structural steel conforming to IS:2062, asphaltic plug to consist of polymer modified bitumen, carefully selected single size aggregate of 12.5 mm nominal size and heat resistant foam caulking/backer rod, all as per approved drawings and specifications.

data.name: Elastomeric Slab Steel Expansion Joint
data.description: Providing and laying of an elastomeric slab steel expansion joint, catering to right or skew (less than 20 deg.), moderately curved with maximum horizontal movement upto 50 mm, complete as per approved drawings and standard specifications to be installed by the manufacturer/supplier or their authorised representative ensuring compliance to the manufacturer's instructions for installation and Clause 2606 of MoRTH Specifications for Road & Bridge Works.

data.name: Compression Seal Joint
data.description: Providing and laying of compression seal joint consisting of steel armoured nosing at two edges of the joint gap suitably anchored to the deck concrete and a preformed chloroprene elastomer or closed cell foam joint sealer compressed and fixed into the joint gap with special adhesive binder to cater for a horizontal movement upto 40 mm and vertical movement of 3 mm.

data.name: Strip Seal Expansion Joint
data.description: Providing and laying of a strip seal expansion joint catering to maximum horizontal movement upto 70 mm, complete as per approved drawings and standard specifications to be installed by the manufacturer/supplier or their authorised representative ensuring compliance to the manufacturer's instructions for installation.

data.name: Modular Strip / Box Seal Joint (70–140 mm)
data.description: Providing and laying of a modular strip box seal expansion joint including anchorage catering to a horizontal movement beyond 70 mm and upto 140 mm, complete as per approved drawings and standard specifications to be installed by the manufacturer/supplier or their authorised representative ensuring compliance to the manufacturer's instructions for installation.

data.name: Modular Strip / Box Seal Joint (140–210 mm)
data.description: Providing and laying of a modular strip box seal expansion joint catering to a horizontal movement beyond 140 mm and upto 210 mm, complete as per approved drawings and standard specifications to be installed by the manufacturer/supplier or their authorised representative ensuring compliance to the manufacturer's instructions for installation.

data.name: Boulder Apron Laid Dry Without Wire Crates
data.description: Providing and laying boulders apron on river bed for protection against scour with stone boulders weighing not less than 40 kg each complete as per drawing and Technical specification. (Boulder Laid Dry Without Wire Crates)

data.name: Boulder Apron Laid in Wire Crates
data.description: Providing and laying of boulder apron laid in wire crates made with 4 mm dia GI wire conforming to IS:280 & IS:4826 in 100 mm × 100 mm mesh (weaved diagonally) including 10 per cent extra for laps and joints laid with stone boulders weighing not less than 40 kg each.

data.name: Cement Concrete Blocks (0.5 × 0.5 × 0.5 m)
data.description: Providing and laying of apron with cement concrete blocks of size 0.5 × 0.5 × 0.5 m cast in-situ and made with nominal mix of M15 grade cement concrete with a minimum cement content of 250 kg/cum as per IRC:21-2000.

data.name: Pitching on Slopes – Stone/Boulder
data.description: Providing and laying Pitching on slopes laid over prepared filter media including boulder apron laid dry in front of toe of embankment complete as per drawing and Technical specifications. (Stone/Boulder)

data.name: Pitching on Slopes – Cement Concrete Blocks Grade M15 (0.3 × 0.3 × 0.3 m)
data.description: Providing and laying Pitching on slopes laid over prepared filter media including boulder apron laid dry in front of toe of embankment complete as per drawing and Technical specifications. (Cement Concrete Blocks of size 0.3 × 0.3 × 0.3 m cast in cement concrete of Grade M15)

data.name: Filter Material Underneath Pitching in Slopes
data.description: Providing and laying Filter material underneath pitching in slopes complete as per drawing and Technical specification.

data.name: Geotextile Filter
data.description: Laying of a geotextile filter between pitching and embankment slopes on which pitching is laid to prevent escape of the embankment material through the voids of the stone pitching/cement concrete blocks as well as to allow free movement of water without creating any uplift head on the pitching.

data.name: Flooring – Rubble Stone Laid in Cement Mortar 1:3
data.description: Providing and laying Flooring complete as per drawing and Technical specifications laid over cement concrete bedding. (Rubble stone laid in cement mortar 1:3)

data.name: Flooring – Cement Concrete Blocks Grade M15
data.description: Providing and laying Flooring complete as per drawing and Technical specifications laid over cement concrete bedding. (Cement Concrete Blocks Grade M15)

data.name: Dry Rubble Flooring
data.description: Construction of dry rubble flooring at cross drainage works for relatively less important works.

data.name: Curtain Wall – Stone Masonry in Cement Mortar (1:3)
data.description: Curtain wall complete as per drawing and Technical specification. (Stone masonry in cement mortar (1:3))

data.name: Curtain Wall – Cement Concrete Grade M15
data.description: Curtain wall complete as per drawing and Technical specification. (Cement concrete Grade M15)

data.name: Flexible Apron
data.description: Construction of flexible apron 1 m thick comprising of loose stone boulders weighing not less than 40 kg beyond curtain wall.

data.name: Gabian Structure for Retaining Earth
data.description: Providing and construction of a gabian structure for retaining earth with segments of wire crates of size 7 m × 3 m × 0.6 m each divided into 1.5 m compartments by cross netting, made from 4 mm galvanised steel wire @ 32 kg per 10 sqm having minimum tensile strength of 300 MPa conforming to IS:280 and galvanizing coating conforming to IS:4826, woven into mesh with double twist, mesh size not exceeding 100 × 100 mm, filled with boulders with least dimension of 200 mm, all loose ends to be tied with 4 mm galvanised steel wire.

data.name: Gabian Structure for Erosion Control, River Training Works and Protection Works
data.description: Providing and constructing gabian structures for erosion control, river training works and protection works with wire crates of size 2 m × 1 m × 0.3 m each divided into 1 m compartments by cross netting, made from 4 mm galvanised steel wire @ 32 kg per 10 sqm having minimum tensile strength of 300 MPa conforming to IS:280 and galvanizing coating conforming to IS:4826, woven into mesh with double twist, mesh size not exceeding 100 × 100 mm, filled with boulders with least dimension of 200 mm, all loose ends to be securely tied with 4 mm galvanised steel wire.
